<img class="publication-figure" src="assets/figures/figure_02_europe_maps.png" alt="Figure 2">

<div class="figcaption"><strong>Figure 2.</strong> Posterior median P-scores for the initial and Delta waves across 33 Eurostat geographies, England and Wales (labelled UK in the map), and Ireland (IE), stratified by displayed age group.</div>

England-and-Wales groups `UNDER65` and `65-84` are displayed in the `40-59` and
`60-79` panels, respectively; Ireland groups `45-64` and `65-84` are displayed
in those panels. These are closest-available source groups and are not fully
harmonized age intervals.
